name: Hostile strings across capability-rule statements
note: IAM-504 fixture matrix: hostile-string-rendering witness for the capability rules. Every statement carries an HTML/JS payload in its Sid and (where applicable) its Resource ARN, while its actions genuinely trigger a rule. analyze() must surface each finding with the hostile string carried verbatim as inert DATA (statementSid / resources / conditions) so the createElement+textContent renderer receives inert text - never markup. Covers WILDCARD-ACTION, WILDCARD-RESOURCE, DATA-EXFIL, KMS-DECRYPT, DESTRUCTIVE-ACTION, DETECTION-IMPAIRMENT, DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN, NOTACTION-ALLOW (plus the escalation paths the NotAction inversion necessarily grants).
